title.if-installed: Video Control Center Standalone Smoke Detection System

procitem.title: Procedure to be developed in the operator's MEL

inform.para: A procedure must be established to check every 30 the absence of smell of burning or smoke in the VCC, and the absence of failure message on the IFE control panel.

condition.subtitle: false
condition.intro: If cabin crew or passengers report anomalies like video/audio distribution problems:

inform.para: The VCC must be checked immediately to ensure that no smoke exists.

condition.subtitle: false
condition.intro: If smell of burning or smoke is suspected, or if a failure message is displayed on the IFE control panel:

inform.para: The VCC must be set to off.
